title: Two saturating operators: non-substitutability of human and machine contribution in AI-assisted discovery
description:
Humans and AI systems are usually placed on one capability curve and asked who is ahead. We formalize the alternative: the two parties act on different variables, and each saturates on a different axis. A machine compresses the residual toward a floor it cannot pass, bounded by log(e0/Phi); a human moves the floor itself, unbounded. Headcount saturates immediately, and corpus size saturates because only the single item certifying the lowest floor determines the attainable bound.

153 machine-checked theorems and 20 worked examples across twelve Lean 4 modules, zero sorry, no axioms beyond Classical.choice, Quot.sound and propext.
